{{Top|leg}}
'''Tar-fuel''' was a substance with a strong smell that was used for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] used tar-fuel on her ship ''[[Cornucopia]]'' to hide the scent of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kina Ha]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] from an [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]] the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were using to inspect her ship.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
